text: {"lessons":["I should set position limits and reassess the reasons for holding a stock; repeatedly selling Stock A at steep losses suggests I let a losing position grow too large before acting.","I should take profits according to a plan, not just because gains feel good: selling Stock B in pieces locked in gains, but I need to weigh that against its remaining outlook and my overall allocation.","I should manage risk across the whole portfolio and avoid reacting to short-term account swings; diversification and clear rules for buys, holds, and sells matter more than any single trade."]}
